repair_history.fixed_sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScoreWrite,
    s.Phone AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores f ON s.CDSCode = f.cds
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;
```
